content.description: 25 tabletop-RPG-style fantasy characters in cel-shaded comic art. Each character ships as a 512x512 avatar/faceset, a large full-body illustration (about 1000-2000 px tall), and a white-outlined sticker version. Cast spans humans, elves, goblins/orcs, birdfolk and undead/demonic figures: knights, priests, townsfolk, warriors, wizards and rogues. Bold outlines, warm earthy palettes, expressive faces. Ideal for visual-novel portraits, character cards, dialogue icons and TTRPG tokens.
